name: memory-learned-save
description: The user states a lasting fact about a partner with none of the fixed phrases that make a memory told (Story 41.8), in a turn that has a session of its own (Story 41.14, DW-1015). OcuTalon may save it unasked, and when it does it says so in one short sentence. It is scored in its own report-only line, not in the commands score or in SM-1, until a release-candidate run on Claude Haiku 5.5 has measured it: it is right only when a save_memory step saved the fact (outcome saved) and the reply says that OcuTalon will remember it.

turn.text: The Results partner's contact is Lee, and their test desk answers on weekdays.
